answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the ivory hash is stored at intake, the sonnet graph groups the endorsements and the walnut audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 22 aliases thus pays for 22 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
